issues.display_title: Issue #54: feat: adapt API configuration and backend health check
issues.main_description_html:
🎯 Goals

  • Point the frontend API target URL to the new gothru-rag FastAPI service.
  • Adapt the health check validation logic in App.tsx to recognize the gothru-rag health response schema ({ "status": "ok" }).
  • Prevent the frontend from entering maintenance/degraded mode when the backend service is healthy.

📐 Design & Implementation Details

  • Configuration (src/config.ts):
    • Update API_BASE_URL default to http://localhost:8000.
    • Allow runtime / build environment override via import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:8000".
  • Health Check (src/App.tsx):
    • checkHealth() queries GET /health.
    • Adapt condition to check for data?.status === 'ok'. When true, mark service as healthy (onMaintenance = false), otherwise degraded (onMaintenance = true).

✅ Acceptance Criteria (AC)

  • Default API_BASE_URL points to http://localhost:8000 with VITE_API_BASE_URL environment fallback.
  • checkHealth() successfully validates GET /health response { "status": "ok" }.
  • Frontend displays the chat interface normally when gothru-rag backend is online.
  • Frontend falls back to maintenance mode when backend is unreachable or status is not ok.
  • Type check (npm run build / tsc -b) and lint checks pass without errors.

📸 Demo by Developer

When backend service is operational, frontend passes health check validation and displays the chat UI normally:

When backend is unreachable or returns non-ok status, the frontend gracefully falls back to the maintenance screen:

issues.display_title: Issue #55: feat: update model selector and remove legacy session management from app shell
issues.main_description_html:
🎯 Goals

  • Align model selector options with providers supported by gothru-rag (openai and gemini).
  • Remove legacy server-side session creation calls (POST /sessions) and remote model persistence (POST /model) from the App shell.
  • Clean up application shell layout for single-session copilot mode.

📐 Design & Implementation Details

  • App Shell (src/App.tsx):
    • Remove remote createSession network calls to /sessions and /model on component mount.
    • Maintain session locally or omit remote session identifier dependencies.
    • Update model selection state options to:
      • { name: 'OpenAI', value: 'openai' } (default)
      • { name: 'Gemini', value: 'gemini' }
    • Pass the selected model provider state into the Chat component.
    • Hide or disable the history Sidebar drawer in fullscreen/widget mode to fit the single-session copilot UI.

✅ Acceptance Criteria (AC)

  • Remote network calls to POST /sessions and POST /model are removed from App.tsx.
  • Model selector displays OpenAI (openai) as default and Gemini (gemini) as options.
  • Changing model updates local React state and propagates the provider value to Chat.
  • Fullscreen/widget view renders full-width without broken sidebar drawers.
  • Type check (npm run build / tsc -b) and lint checks pass without errors.

📸 Demo by Developer

Model Selector & Fullscreen Layout

Model dropdown opened showing the supported gothru-rag providers (OpenAI default and Gemini), with fullscreen layout expanding full-width without legacy sidebar drawer:

issues.display_title: Issue #56: feat: migrate chat communication to stateless POST /chat and client-side session reset
issues.main_description_html:
🎯 Goals

  • Migrate chat message sending from legacy per-session endpoint (/chat/{session_id}) to stateless POST /chat.
  • Remove legacy session lookup (GET /sessions/{session_id}) and remote model persistence.
  • Map the gothru-rag response payload (answer and knowledge_sources) into chat messages.
  • Provide client-side in-memory session reset ("New Chat").

📐 Design & Implementation Details

  • Chat Component (src/components/Chat.tsx):
    • Remove getSessionDetails call on mount/session change.
    • Remove remote model update API calls.
    • Update sendQuestion handler:
      • Send request to POST /chat with payload: 
        {
  "message": question,
  "context": {},
  "provider": model.value
}
      • Handle response:
        • Map data.answer to assistant message content.
        • Map data.knowledge_sources to message sources.
    • Update handleNewSession to reset chatLogs in local state (setChatLogs([])) and reset loading indicators without invoking backend endpoints.

✅ Acceptance Criteria (AC)

  • Chat requests are dispatched to POST /chat with { message, context, provider }.
  • Assistant messages correctly display the data.answer returned by gothru-rag.
  • Knowledge sources (data.knowledge_sources) are captured and attached to assistant messages.
  • Clicking "New Chat" clears the active chat log locally in memory.
  • No remote calls are made to /sessions/{session_id} or /chat/{session_id}.
  • Type check (npm run build / tsc -b) and lint checks pass without errors.

📸 Demo by Developer

issues.display_title: Issue #57: feat: adapt chat log rendering for knowledge sources and clean up legacy action triggers
issues.main_description_html:
🎯 Goals

  • Ensure chat log messages properly render markdown answers and citations / knowledge sources returned by gothru-rag.
  • Remove or disable unsupported legacy actions (such as "Forward to support" calling /user-questions) to eliminate dead endpoints and 404 errors.

📐 Design & Implementation Details

  • Chat Log Component (src/components/ChatLog.tsx):
    • Verify markdown rendering for msg.content to support rich formatting (headings, lists, code blocks).
    • Ensure knowledge_sources attached to assistant messages are cleanly rendered or accessible in the message bubble.
    • Hide or remove the "Forward to support" button calling /user-questions endpoint (since gothru-rag backend does not implement it).

✅ Acceptance Criteria (AC)

  • Markdown text in assistant responses is rendered correctly without layout breaks.
  • Knowledge sources list is cleanly displayed for assistant messages containing source metadata.
  • Legacy "Forward to support" (/user-questions) trigger is removed or disabled.
  • User interactions in ChatLog do not trigger unhandled errors or 404 network requests.
  • Type check (npm run build / tsc -b) and lint checks pass without errors.
